problem: Current runtime evidence needs two independent identities: WHAT exact code/artifact/harness executed and WHERE/THROUGH WHICH authorized execution surface it actually executed. A content/boundary fingerprint cannot prove target-host execution, while a runner/route observation cannot prove exact subject bytes. Collapsing either axis allows cross-surface or cross-subject credit substitution.
observations: The exact WP1207 component-CI workflow declares runs-on: ubuntu-latest, and run 33311147892/job 99256303130 executed successfully on GitHub Actions runner 1000051152 with GitHub Actions group identity.
Current owner authority identifies clay-direct-dev as the intended Frankenstein-2.0 build/test/runtime sandbox and the self-hosted runner/VPS bridge as an authorized transport.
The current execution-surface resolver already separates route reachability, authority, target health and evidence admission; its routing receipt explicitly cannot mint runtime credit.
The parallel RUNTIME_SUBJECT_BOUNDARY_FINGERPRINT E2 addresses exact subject/input/harness currentness but not target-surface identity.

GitHub's workflow syntax makes runs-on an intended eligibility/destination contract; GitHub's workflow-jobs API exposes observed runner identity, runner group, labels, run attempt, source SHA and step execution. These are complementary rather than interchangeable.

selected_architecture_delta.name: RUNTIME_EXECUTION_SURFACE_BINDING

two_axis_subject_model.what_axis: RUNTIME_SUBJECT_BOUNDARY_FINGERPRINT or equivalent exact source/artifact/harness identity
two_axis_subject_model.where_axis: RUNTIME_EXECUTION_SURFACE_BINDING: intended target/route contract plus observed host/runner/route identity

minimum_surface_contract: executor/workflow identity and digest/path when applicable
normalized intended runner group/labels or bridge target contract
minimum_surface_observation: host identity digest/readback when a generic self-hosted pool could contain multiple hosts
admission_rules: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest success is component-CI evidence only when the required target is clay-direct-dev.
A queued self-hosted job with no observed runner/steps is route/control-plane evidence only.

A self-hosted runner label or group proves eligibility class, not necessarily a unique physical target host; target-host credit requires an observed runner identity mapped to the intended surface or an in-run host readback/equivalent receipt.
A bridge roundtrip proves route reachability only until the bound command/artifact actually executes and a target result receipt is captured.
Surface mismatch preserves the narrower evidence instead of converting it into product failure or success.
Authority or route observation staleness forces re-resolution before promotion-bearing execution.

counterhypotheses.claim: Exact source/artifact provenance alone is enough for target-runtime credit.
counterhypotheses.reason: The same bytes can execute on GitHub-hosted CI or clay-direct-dev; provenance does not identify the execution surface.

counterhypotheses.claim: Observed runner labels alone are enough to prove the target host.
counterhypotheses.reason: Labels/groups define eligibility and may match multiple runners. A unique target needs an observed runner-to-target binding or target-local readback.

counterhypotheses.claim: The existing ubuntu-latest WP1207 workflow should be changed to self-hosted so one workflow provides all evidence.
counterhypotheses.reason: Current hosted CI is valid cheap component evidence. The target-host gate is a distinct evidence scope and may use the authorized bridge/self-hosted route without sacrificing hosted CI.

counterhypotheses.claim: Execution-surface resolution already solves this completely.
counterhypotheses.reason: The resolver selects/classifies routes and explicitly grants routing evidence only. Runtime admission still needs the selected contract bound to the observed execution result.

required_falsifiers_before_E5: HOSTED_SUBSTITUTION: prove a GitHub-hosted success with exact source cannot satisfy a clay-direct-dev target contract.
QUEUED_NO_EXECUTION: prove a self-hosted queued job with no runner/steps yields zero target-runtime credit.
POOL_AMBIGUITY: show a generic self-hosted label/group can address more than one runner or otherwise fail unique-host identity, forcing target readback/mapping when unique host matters.
ROUTE_STALENESS: change/expire route observation or authority generation and prove prior resolution cannot authorize promotion-bearing admission without revalidation.

WHAT_WHERE_ORTHOGONALITY: keep surface identity fixed while mutating bound subject bytes, and keep subject bytes fixed while changing execution surface; each change independently invalidates target promotion.
NO_CREDIT_INFLATION: passing WHAT+WHERE at one component scope must not mint physical GRID10 or whole-system acceptance.
